title: 255 Leyte students get free eyeglasses to improve classroom learning

blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — Some 255 students in Alangalang and MacArthur towns in Leyte have received free prescription eyeglasses after a vision screening found them struggling with eyesight problems that could affect their classroom performance. The 255 beneficiaries got their eyeglasses on Tuesday, Nov. 17, through a school-based vision care program of the Mabuhay Deseret Foundation
